review_candidates.title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer

Technology is no longer a support function. It is the engine of our competitive differentiation. The Lead Infrastructure Engineer is the senior hands-on engineer in JTC's infrastructure team. You will design the solution and then build it yourself. Around half of your week is spent at the keyboard. That means building servers and Azure services, writing Terraform, changing firewalls and VPNs, migrating systems and resolving the problems that have beaten everyone else. The other half is planning and design. You will work out how an acquired business, a legacy application or a new AI workload should land on our platform, and what it will take to get it there. This is not a head of function or a pure architecture role, and it has no direct reports. You will report to the Head of Infrastructure and work as their technical partner in a small team across Jersey and London, setting the technical direction for projects and guiding colleagues through delivery. If your recent work has been mostly managing people, suppliers or roadmaps, this is unlikely to be the right role for you. The work is varied. JTC's architecture is Microsoft-primary. Our Citrix desktop estate and newer workloads run in Azure, while legacy applications remain in on-premises Hyper-V data centres that we intend to exit. We grow through acquisition, so integrating a new business from discovery through to cutover is a regular part of the job. Many of the systems you inherit will have little or no documentation, and we need an engineer who can work out what exists and write it down. Financial services demands a higher standard. Our infrastructure carries client assets, regulatory obligations and audit trails across multiple jurisdictions. You will bring that rigour to every change, security decision and recovery test, and you will build automation, observability and security in from the start as we scale the Azure foundations for JTC's AI programme. Main Responsibilities And Duties HANDS-ON PLATFORM ENGINEERING You will build and run JTC's Azure and hybrid platform yourself, working alongside the rest of the infrastructure team. Build, configure and maintain Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, SQL managed instances, storage, networking, App Services and the landing zones that host them. Own Azure governance in practice, covering management groups, policy assignments, role-based access, tagging and cost management. Deliver network and connectivity changes such as site-to-site VPNs, ExpressRoute, firewall rules, DNS and network segmentation.
